answer: Audits are published in anchor, queued in tundra, and walnut publishes the wait time. A farm of 351 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 73 identities per epoch. A farm of 847 identities would post 899 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
